Colombia's **National Energy Plan 2025–2055** was published by the National Mining and Energy Planning Unit (**UPME**). I served as the lead modeler for the transport sector and contributed to the full energy system model underlying the plan's three long-term scenarios: Declared Policies, Announced Policies, and Carbon Neutrality.

The plan is Colombia's primary long-term energy planning instrument and sets the quantitative framework for the country's just energy transition through 2055. The full document is available on the [UPME website](https://www.upme.gov.co/simec/planeacion-energetica/plan-energetico-nacional-1/){target="_blank"}.
